# Week 1
## Full Body A
main / used: none / 2x5, 1x5+ / 150s / progress: lp(5lb)
build / used: none / 3x8 / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
iso / used: none / 2x12 / 60s / progress: dp(2.5lb, 12, 15)
bw / used: none / 3x6 / 0lb / 60s / warmup: none / progress: custom() {~
  if (completedReps >= reps && reps[1] < 12) {
    reps += 1
  }
~}
run / used: none / 1x1 0lb 600s|0s / warmup: none
mobility / used: none / 2x1 0lb 45s|15s / warmup: none

Goblet Squat / ...main / 30lb
// No bench? Press from the floor.
Bench Press, Dumbbell / ...main / 30lb
Bent Over One Arm Row / ...build / 30lb
Single Leg Deadlift / ...build / 25lb
Lateral Raise / ...iso / 10lb
// 10 easy minutes. A jog outside counts too.
High Knee Skips / ...run

## Full Body B
Romanian Deadlift / ...main / 40lb
Shoulder Press / ...main / 20lb
Pullover / ...build / 25lb
Lunge, Dumbbell / ...build / 20lb
Skullcrusher, Dumbbell / ...iso / 15lb
Standing Calf Raise / ...iso / 30lb

## Full Body C
Squat, Dumbbell / ...main / 25lb
// Hands on a table or a bench.
Incline Push Up / ...bw
Bent Over Row, Dumbbell / ...main / 25lb
Glute Bridge / ...build / 40lb
Hammer Curl / ...iso / 15lb
// Sit in a deep squat. Hold a door frame for balance.
Assisted Squat / ...mobility
// Slow, no weight. Sit tall and turn your chest side to side.
Russian Twist / ...mobility
// Slow reach to the floor. Feel the back of the leg.
Single Leg Deadlift, Bodyweight / ...mobility
